units.source_text: 名人身旁放了一个梧桐木大火盆，后来他让人把另一个长火盆搁在他背后。

en.t: A large paulownia-wood brazier was placed beside the master, and later he had another long brazier set behind him.
Steam rose thickly from the kettle.

units.source_text: 由于七段劝说“请随便吧”，他也就依然系着围巾，裹着防寒服。

en.t: Since the seventh-dan player urged him, "Please make yourself comfortable," he kept his scarf on and remained wrapped in his cold-weather coat.

units.source_text: 它似乎是毛线里、毛毡面的，类似短和服外褂。

en.t: It seemed to have a woolen lining and a felt outer surface, rather like a short kimono jacket.

units.source_text: 在他自己的房间里，他也离不开这些东西。

en.t: Even in his own room, he could not do without these things.

units.source_text: 据说当天他发起低烧来了。

en.t: It was said that he began running a slight fever that day.
